purpose: Test one deployment scenario where immutable packed metadata can help: fan out a large base into independent writable workspaces.
arms: BrewFS packed lower + TiKV upper, current main
primary_metric: One-time packing or native import plus the complete four-workspace lifecycle, with prewarm, reads, COW, final upload drain, unmount and process exit included.
validation: Remote object checksums, source immutability, workspace isolation and full namespace counts after the timed window.
caveats: S3-compatible RustFS and TiKV share one owned 8-vCPU 32-GiB VM; not a remote OSS/S3 or HA claim.
Half the selected working set is pre-read; no 50-percent steady cache-hit claim.
Metadata cache implementations differ; payload caches are disabled. Internal request scheduling is not identical.
Both successful and unsuccessful size points remain in the report.
The shelved transaction optimizer is not used in either arm.
